newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer rises sharply on buyback speculation.
newsitem.headline: Amer rises sharply on buyback speculation.

text.p: Shares in Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy rose sharply on Monday on position taking ahead of a decision expected this week on whether Amer will redeem vote-heavy K shares sold a month ago, brokers said.
At 1615/1315 GMT, Amer traded at 92.00 markka, up 4.00 markka or more than four percent, in fairly lively 20 million markka turnover on an otherwise quiet bourse.
"This seems to be related to speculation over what the company and the K-shareholders will do," one broker said.

He was referring to Amer's and its K-shareholders' right to redeem the 275,000 K shares sold at end-June to British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinnness, third Lord Moyne by one of four Finnish institutions which own all the K series shares.
Amer spokeswoman Marja-Leena Simola said the board would meet this week, but she declined to say when.
